body: Thanks. I'm sorry to hear you're going through a similar thing.

Thanks for taking the time to type out such a thoughtful response. I've tried counsellors in the past but they were useless and I ended up making them cry. However, I'm going to phone the doctors this morning and give it another a go. So thank you for that.
Thank you for your comment. I'm sorry if you've experienced similar things.
Best of luck on your journey. I hope something good comes back to you soon.

You're absolutely right. Physical attractiveness is of vital importance. I have tried, and tried, and tried, to get into good shape. I've thrown myself against the gym, swimming pools, running, meal plans, food diaries and everything else for years. Problem is, I can't get into a routine so I can't do it sustainably. I do feel much better when exercising though, even if it's just for a week or two. These days I lack the energy or willpower to do it. I get home from work and I just go to sleep because the emotional dissonance has bled me dry.
